description: Required GitHub Project fields for the canonical Pan queue. This manifest contains field names and formats, never project values.

fields.name: requirements
fields.format: newline-delimited playbook selectors: exactly one repo:<owner>/<name> entry plus capability tokens a runner advertises in its profile. Never invent a token from the Issue text. Delivery method, process, environment, and tooling preferences do not belong here; a token no playbook advertises makes the task permanently unclaimable.

fields.name: needs-human-since
fields.format: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp; empty means no human is needed

fields.name: workstream
fields.format: optional full https://github.com/<configured-domain>/issues/<number> URL. A non-empty value must resolve to an Issue carrying the exact Workstream label.
